Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao

 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.4895 Of 2019
Order:

The petitioner/accused seeks to quash the proceedings against him in C.C.No.1813 of 2019 on the file of Special Judicial First Class Magistrate for Prohibition & Excise, Guntur, which was taken cognizance for the offences under Sections 270, 273 and 284 of IPC and Sections 57(1) and 58 of Food Safety and Standards Act (for short, 'FSS Act').

entities.text: Special Judicial First Class Magistrate for Prohibition & Excise, Guntur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. The allegations against the petitioner briefly are that on 23.04.2019 at 12.30 p.m., when the complainant along with his staff reached 1st Lane, Krishna Nagar, on suspicion, caught the accused and found the banned tobacco products in their possession and hence, seized the same and registered a case in Crime No.182 of 2019 of Pattabhipuram Police Station, Guntur Urban, for the offences stated supra.
3.

Learned counsel for petitioner while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore, the Police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore, registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the order of this Court in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the criminal petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioners/accused under Sections 270, 273 and 284 of IPC and Sections 57(1) and 58 of FSS Act are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this case shall stand closed.

_ U. DURGA PRASAD RAO, J 16.09.2019 SS Susanth Kumar Roht Susantha Rao, vs State Of Ap on 16 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170678619/
